description: This file is a shell script used for testing various functionalities of 'git bundle', including creation, verification, cloning, and filtering of bundles, as well as testing error conditions and progress reporting.

methods.name: test_commit_setvar
methods.description: Creates a commit or tag and sets a variable with its object ID, allowing options for merge, tag, signoff, and directory.

methods.name: get_abbrev_oid
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated object ID based on the provided full object ID.

methods.name: make_user_friendly_and_stable_output
methods.description: Formats git command output to replace commit hashes and tags with placeholders for stable comparison.

methods.name: format_and_save_expect
methods.description: Prepares expected output files for comparison in tests.
